parameters.name: time_periods
parameters.description: Planning horizon with a single period

parameters.name: unit_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit for each product type

parameters.name: wood_requirement
parameters.description: Wood usage per unit for each product type

parameters.name: steel_requirement
parameters.description: Steel usage per unit for each product type

parameters.name: market_demand
parameters.description: Optional maximum sellable quantity for each product type, if provided

parameters.name: forbidden_pairs
parameters.description: Ordered pairs of product types where manufacturing the first forbids manufacturing the second

parameters.name: implication_pairs
parameters.description: Ordered pairs of product types where manufacturing the first requires manufacturing the second

parameters.name: quantity_ordering_pairs
parameters.description: Ordered pairs of product types where the first product quantity cannot exceed the second

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Production quantity for each product type

variables.name: manufacture_indicator
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if the product type is manufactured and 0 otherwise

auxiliary_variables.name: production_upper_bound
auxiliary_variables.description: Per-product upper bound used in the selection-linking constraint, computed as the minimum of the resource-implied and demand-implied limits for each product.

constraints.name: wood_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total wood usage by all production quantities cannot exceed available wood capacity

constraints.name: steel_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total steel usage by all production quantities cannot exceed available steel capacity

constraints.name: link_production_to_selection
constraints.description: Production is allowed only if a product is selected, and if selected it may produce at most the per-product upper bound.

constraints.name: market_demand_cap
constraints.description: If a market demand cap is provided, production quantity for each product cannot exceed its demand limit.

constraints.name: forbidden_manufacturing_pairs
constraints.description: For each forbidden pair, manufacturing the first product forbids manufacturing the second product

constraints.name: implication_manufacturing_pairs
constraints.description: For each implication pair, manufacturing the first product requires manufacturing the second product

constraints.name: quantity_ordering_pairs
constraints.description: For each quantity ordering pair, the production quantity of the first product cannot exceed the production quantity of the second product

constraints.name: manufactured_type_count_definition
constraints.description: The count variable equals the number of products with manufacture indicator equal to one

constraints.name: single_period_horizon
constraints.description: The planning horizon is single-period with exactly one time period.

constraints.name: production_upper_bound_definition
constraints.description: Define the per-product upper bound used in the linking constraint as the minimum of the available resource-based and optional demand-based limits.

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit across all manufactured products

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit from produced quantities across all products in the single-period planning model.
